{
  "pros": [
    "Simple, intuitive, and easy to get started with for all team members.",
    "Excellent for organizing project communication and reducing internal meetings.",
    "Flat-rate pricing offers great value for larger teams and predictable costs.",
    "Provides a clear, structured way to manage projects with distinct tools.",
    "Reliable performance and a clutter-free interface.",
    "Strong focus on asynchronous communication and keeping conversations in context."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited customization options compared to more flexible competitors.",
    "Fewer integrations with other business tools than many alternatives.",
    "May lack advanced features or reporting capabilities needed by some teams.",
    "Can feel restrictive for users accustomed to highly configurable platforms.",
    "Flat pricing might be less cost-effective for very small teams.",
    "Reporting and overview capabilities for project progress can be basic."
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Cons item 6: 'Users might need to adapt to Basecamp's specific workflow' replaced with 'Reporting and overview capabilities for project progress can be basic' based on the note '[friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool.' and '[friction] There is no approval status or approval field on to-dos; the only way I found to see 'pending approval' was the to-do Filter box, a plain keyword match that showed 'Material Selection Approval' but not 'Final Blueprint Sign-off'.'"
  ]

pros: Simple, intuitive, and easy to get started with for all team members.
Excellent for organizing project communication and reducing internal meetings.
Flat-rate pricing offers great value for larger teams and predictable costs.
Provides a clear, structured way to manage projects with distinct tools.
Reliable performance and a clutter-free interface.
Strong focus on asynchronous communication and keeping conversations in context.
cons: Limited customization options compared to more flexible competitors.
Fewer integrations with other business tools than many alternatives.
May lack advanced features or reporting capabilities needed by some teams.
Can feel restrictive for users accustomed to highly configurable platforms.
Flat pricing might be less cost-effective for very small teams.
Reporting and overview capabilities for project progress can be basic.
changed: Cons item 6: 'Users might need to adapt to Basecamp's specific workflow' replaced with 'Reporting and overview capabilities for project progress can be basic' based on the note '[friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool.' and '[friction] There is no approval status or approval field on to-dos; the only way I found to see 'pending approval' was the to-do Filter box, a plain keyword match that showed 'Material Selection Approval' but not 'Final Blueprint Sign-off'.'
